text: I was at the Regency until three. I didn't touch the garage keys on Saturday, I haven't been near that car in weeks, and I don't want to talk about my father's collection.

assertions.claim: I didn't touch any of the roadster's keys on Saturday.
assertions.note: He borrowed the spare key to have the car photographed for a sale brochure, behind his father's back.

text: I serviced her on Thursday and I haven't set eyes on her since. The spare key is on my board where it always is.

assertions.claim: I haven't been to the garage since Thursday.

text: I went to bed at eleven and slept till six. I didn't go into the garage and I didn't go out onto the lane. I came down at seven for the Sunday polish and the bay was empty. I've never had anything to do with car transporters in my life.

assertions.claim: I didn't go into the garage between eleven and six.
I didn't go out onto the lane that night.
I've never had anything to do with a transport firm.

text: My valuation was routine and overdue. I've never been told the alarm codes and I wouldn't want them.

assertions.claim: I've never been told the alarm codes.

text: I was at the Motor Club all evening and slept there. I never went near Ashgrove Road on Saturday night. If I wanted that car, I'd buy it.

assertions.claim: I never went near Ashgrove Road on Saturday night.
assertions.note: He drove out to make one last offer, lost his nerve at the gate, and was back at the club by twenty past twelve.
